source_snapshot.test_set: Intel CPU RAS -UPI Data Lane Failover
source_snapshot.procedure: Apply EDKII injection/debug settings, deploy Intel ITP, boot Windows, log and halt, inspect pcie.topology()/pcie.port_map(), choose the PCIe slot target, invoke ei.injUpiDataLinkFailover(socket,port,1,0x3), resume and collect evidence.
source_snapshot.criteria: System operates normally; BMC may show link disable/degrade for advanced RAS or correctable error for standard; front-panel light differs by RAS SKU; UEFI SEL may record the event.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; leaves BIOS and Intel harness injection to user/FAE and suggests agent-side dmesg/BMC SEL capture.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; adds topology, exact CPU RAS SKU expectation, one bounded injection, recovery and restoration.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>pcie.topology() >>>pcie.port_map() 6. Check PCIe slot target >>>ei.injUpiDataLinkFailover(socket,port,1,0x3) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record upi link disable/degrade(advanced) or correctable error(standard) 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if CPU is standard RAS SKU 4. Front Panel fault Light will Light if CPU is advanced RAS SKU 5. uEFI SEL Log may record same event
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Socket 0~N (Intel UPI data-lane failover on Socket 0~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'upi|datalane|failover|lane'; echo __UPI_data-lane_failover_on_Socket_0~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

disposition_reason: UPI data-lane failover is a topology-sensitive link event: an integer port in an Intel debug shell is not trustworthy until correlated to the physical socket-to-socket path. The expected response also changes with CPU RAS capability, so `may` cannot serve as a pass rule without a known SKU matrix. Normal operation should include link state and workload/health continuity, not merely a booted console. Because Windows is mandated, the OS oracle must be WHEA/ETW or another approved Windows record instead of assumed dmesg. These issues require engineering inputs and human-controlled injection, but the underlying method is sufficiently defined for REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. test_case.purpose: Inject a UPI data-lane failover condition into each approved socket/link target and demonstrate that the platform remains operational while logging and front-panel behavior match the CPU's standard or advanced RAS capability.
required_package: Board/CPU topology, UPI link/socket/port map and CPU standard-versus-advanced RAS SKU
Supported Intel ITP/CScripts build with checksum and exact injUpiDataLinkFailover parameter semantics
Expected link state and exact OS/BMC/UEFI records for each supported SKU
Front-panel indicator map, injection timeout/abort and vendor recovery/restoration plan
test_case.test_command: An FAE/operator on an isolated Windows SUT enables the exact listed EDKII settings, verifies ITP topology and port mapping against the physical UPI link, performs one approved `injUpiDataLinkFailover` action, resumes the system, assesses live link/system health, collects Windows RAS, BMC and post-recovery UEFI evidence plus the front-panel state, then restores all debug settings. Evidence and expected branch must be fixed before execution.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record upi link disable/degrade(advanced) or correctable error(standard) 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if CPU is standard RAS SKU 4. Front Panel fault Light will Light if CPU is advanced RAS SKU 5. uEFI SEL Log may record same event

safety_gate: Dedicated idle SUT, stable power, independent console and explicit owner/FAE approval
Preserve pre-state logs and topology rather than clearing evidence
Cross-check Cscript port identity against physical UPI topology before injection
Stop for wrong target, uncontrolled degradation, thermal/power fault, lost console, crash or no-boot
Never auto-repeat; restore debug settings and link health only through the approved recovery
expected_evidence: FAE approval, exact SUT/CPU/RAS-SKU/firmware/OS identity and physical UPI topology
Package hash, topology/port-map output, selected link rationale and full injection transcript
Pre/post BIOS setting and link-health comparison
Complete Windows RAS, BMC SEL and recovered UEFI SEL with synchronized timestamps
SKU-specific front-panel photo/video and normal-operation checks
Recovery/restoration record and engineer PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED disposition
test_case.recovery: Inputs and human approval make this conditionally executable, but critical fault injection, BIOS changes and physical observation remain outside autonomous agent authority. A missing package or operator is a blocked run, not a hardware failure.

source_conflict.reason: The SUT is booted into Windows while dmesg is requested, and `may record` leaves BMC/UEFI results non-deterministic. The source also needs an authoritative mapping from standard/advanced CPU RAS SKU to required logs and lamp behavior.

blocked.reason: Execution remains blocked by the case-specific vendor semantics, isolation and recovery listed in pending.remaining_project_configuration.
